1.t: I do swear by the Day of Judgment

2.t: And I do swear by the self-reproaching soul

3.t: Do people think We cannot reassemble their bones

4.t: Yes ˹indeed˺! We are ˹most˺ capable of restoring ˹even˺ their very fingertips

5.t: Still people want to deny what is yet to come

6.t: asking ˹mockingly˺, “When is this Day of Judgment?”

7.t: But when the sight is stunned

9.t: and the sun and the moon are brought together

10.t: on that Day one will cry, “Where is the escape?”

11.t: But no! There will be no refuge

12.t: On that Day all will end up before your Lord

13.t: All will then be informed of what they have sent forth and left behind
13.tr: Yunabba-'ul insaanu yawma-'izim bimaa qaddama Wa-akhkhar

14.t: In fact, people will testify against their own souls

15.t: despite the excuses they come up with

16.t: Do not rush your tongue trying to memorize ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran
16.tr: Laa tuharrik bihee lisaa-naka lita'jala bih

17.t: It is certainly upon Us to ˹make you˺ memorize and recite it

18.t: So once We have recited a revelation ˹through Gabriel˺, follow its recitation ˹closely˺

19.t: Then it is surely upon Us to make it clear ˹to you˺

20.t: But no! In fact, you love this fleeting world

22.t: On that Day ˹some˺ faces will be bright

25.t: anticipating something devastating to befall them

26.t: But no! ˹Beware of the day˺ when the soul reaches the collar bone ˹as it leaves˺

27.t: and it will be said, “Is there any healer ˹who can save this life˺?”

28.t: And the dying person realizes it is ˹their˺ time to depart

29.t: and ˹then˺ their feet are tied together ˹in a shroud˺

30.t: On that day they will be driven to your Lord ˹alone˺

31.t: This denier neither believed nor prayed

32.t: but persisted in denial and turned away

33.t: then went to their own people, walking boastfully

34.t: Woe to you, and more woe

35.t: Again, woe to you, and even more woe

36.t: Do people think they will be left without purpose

37.t: Were they not ˹once˺ a sperm-drop emitted
37.tr: Alam yaku nutfatam mim maniyyiny yumnaa

38.t: Then they became a clinging clot ˹of blood˺, then He developed and perfected their form

39.t: producing from it both sexes, male and female

40.t: Is such ˹a Creator˺ unable to bring the dead back to life
40.tr: Alaisa zaalika biqaadirin 'alaaa any yuhyiyal mawtaa
